final_result.answer:

- On October 19, 2026, the 3-month nominal Treasury constant maturity yield was 4.27 percent per annum (`col1`).
- On October 23, 2026, the 3-month nominal Treasury constant maturity yield was 4.22 percent per annum (`col5`).
